english.title: Fail to comply with requirements of a football restriction order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the subject of a restriction order made under section 15 of the Football Spectators Act 1989, failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with a requirement imposed upon you on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) under section 19(2) of the said Act, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19(6) and (7) of the Football Spectators Act 1989.

english.notes:
IMPORTANT
(i) 'Restriction Orders' were retitled 'International Football Banning Orders' by the Football (Offences and Disorder) Act 1999. Officers should take care when using this heading that the requirements being breached were of a 'Restriction Order' ISSUED PRIOR TO 26.9.99. If the order was issued AFTER THAT DATE and before 27.8.2000 inclusive.the breach would be of an 'International Football Banning Order' and officers should use the offence wording found at H4268.
(ii) See meaning of 'enforcing authority'.
(iii) See offence wordings H3440 for failing to comply with the reporting requirements of a Restriction Order and H4268 for failing to comply with an International Football Banning Order.
(iv) Now PNC recordable from 18/08/07 as per S.I. 2007/2121.
